maria (docs): quick heads-up — I'm doing a small refresh of the onboarding lab for the hello-min app. goal: make first-deploy + auth frictionless (env helper, clear var names, tiny migration note for v1->v2 keys). ok to proceed?

tyler (eng): go for it. agree on standard env names: REDWOOD_API_URL and REDWOOD_API_KEY. saves confusion.

maria (docs): perfect. I'll update docs and examples to use those. planning to add a `scripts/setup-env.sh` helper (prints warnings if KEY is placeholder).

kevin (devex): please add a one-liner Node snippet showing how to load env and call the client. also a short note about streaming vs non-streaming minimal handling.

maria (docs): will keep examples <=5 lines and link to full repo: github.com/redwood-inference/hello-min.

mike (qa): confirm deprecation timeline before we publish any v1->v2 migration text?

maria (docs): QA confirmed: v1 keys deprecated 2026-09-01. I'll add: "If you have v1 keys, generate a v2 key in Console; v1 will be removed."

ci-bot: markdown-lint: passed. link-check: warning -> ./old-examples/auth-v1.md referenced.

maria (docs): thanks bot — removing that link and replacing with migration blurb.

tyler (eng): add a troubleshooting bullet: "401? Check REDWOOD_API_KEY for quotes or whitespace." Cuts down on support pings.

kevin (devex): also add quick curl health check: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" $REDWOOD_API_URL/v1/health` should return 200. put that under "validate your key".

maria (docs): adding Node + Python snippets, env helper, migration note, and the curl test. opening WIP PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1240 (WIP). tagging @tyler @mike @kevin for review. ETA: 1h for review, will merge if no blockers. :rocket:
